LESSON: POLITE LANGUAGE

Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Polite language

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Polite language. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Polite language
2. Practise Polite language at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Polite language

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Polite language
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Polite language. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Polite language at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Polite language at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Polite language
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Polite language. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Polite language using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Polite language in the examples.
2. Explain Polite language to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Polite language.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Polite language using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Polite language important for a PP1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. In pairs, learners could role play making requests and appreciating others.
2. Be guided to deliberately model the habit of making requests and appreciating others as need arises.
3. Be encouraged to make requests and appreciate others during 15 relevant situations in school and at home.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Polite language
2. Practise Polite language at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Polite language

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
